query: raise client_max_body_size from 1m to 50m, leaving every other directive unchanged
check: grep -q 'client_max_body_size 50m' $FILE && ! grep -q 'client_max_body_size 1m' $FILE && grep -q 'proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000' $FILE && grep -q 'server_name app.internal' $FILE

query: change the proxy_pass upstream port from 3000 to 4000 and raise proxy_read_timeout from 30s to 90s
check: grep -q 'proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4000' $FILE && grep -q 'proxy_read_timeout 90s' $FILE && ! grep -q ':3000' $FILE && grep -q 'proxy_set_header Host' $FILE
